sequence: GET .../emotions (only emotions caused by that event, dominant = first, as FatimaCognitionSession)

reading.character: the authored characters differ only in Safe(SELF) significance (how much a threat frightens); pick the one whose significance is nearest 1 - courage
reading.Harm: a hit taken / grievance / betrayal by a partner; level = the grievance toward that club, capped at 1 (a betrayal of an open pact = 1.0)
reading.Threaten: a visible menace (stronger club at war or feared); level = the threat held toward it, capped at 1
reading.Aid: help received (pact offered while at war, support sent); level = its size on 0..1
reading.snap: round the level to the nearest grid step (0.05)
